title: Yara and the Radiators
author: Astrid Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Joubert, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
